description: Cases for the size-split sub-issue trust rule (admit.mjs splitChildBody, owner Q93 with the Q9 extension): a body counts as the listed human's text only when the lanes App wrote it, nobody edited it, its native parent was filed by a listed human, its header names that parent, and every line after the header is a line of the parent's trusted text. Actors are {type, id} with type User or Bot; parent is the child's native parent number or null; size is the triage Size. admit.test.mjs and resolve-pr.test.mjs read this file.

trusted.body:
## Done when

- [ ] Line 3 says nineteen.
- [ ] Line 4 says twenty.
- [ ] Line 5 says twenty-one.
